scope: All generated interface/message entries in eight locales read in the editorial pass
All generated listing prose and screenshot captions inspected
All seven non-English target-word sets and existing English target/bonus sets inspected
All nine displayed voice commands per locale checked against parser examples
fixed_issue_categories: Premium access mistranslated as a subscription
English singular/plural fragments causing inflection errors
Number/noun sentence fragments replaced with count labels
Untranslated landscape names and screenshot headlines
Incorrect speech synthesis versus speech recognition description
Restore treated as a separate app or an application restore
Mixed register in German and European Portuguese
Brazilian and European Portuguese voice commands shared inaccurately
Rare, technical or region-sensitive beginner targets replaced with familiar alternatives
Android 9 ICU regex rejects unescaped closing brace in translation placeholder pattern; both braces are now escaped
Large-text controls wrap whole buttons and board stacks above wheel
Dense crossword letters use an explicit line height to prevent Android 9 clipping
known_remaining_limits: No independent native human certification; fluent regional and audience/difficulty review would increase confidence
Portuguese vocabulary is shared between regional editions
Recognition round trips cannot be tested on this tablet because no recognition service is installed
Amazon console still has the earlier English-only candidate; matching upload and store-delivered release testing remain pending

separate_linguistic_validation.method: Read every authored target/bonus set separately from interface generation; inspect spelling, morphology and meaning; cross-check frequency flags with primary dictionaries; replace obscure introductory entries; re-run structural and accent tests.
